headline: Golden fixture: every control explicitly present in the submission text.

checklist.evidence: select the close period and the entity before any data is pulled
carries its source transaction ID and journal entry number from the GL
their name and email are recorded in the workpaper sign-off block
watermarked DRAFT until the named reviewer signs the Cover tab
requires the user to type CONFIRM before the NetSuite import CSV is written
the skill reconciles the snapshot back to the source system
row count of the extract is tied to the source query count
The user must review and explicitly approve the Judgments tab before the rollforward tabs are finalized
run metadata footer (run ID, UTC timestamp, period, entity, snapshot hash, skill version)
All downstream tabs compute from the locked snapshot, never from a live re-query
listed on the Exclusions tab with the reason — nothing is silently dropped
5% of performance materiality, with the basis and the memo reference stated
Items above the threshold are flagged on the Review tab for human review
listed on the Below-Threshold tab and aggregated by account
formatted xlsx workpaper with Cover, Rollforward, Judgments, Checks, Review
The Cover tab carries the sign-off block: preparer name and timestamp
Every computed cell uses a live Excel formula (SUM, SUMIF, EOMONTH cascades)
